title: execution_observe landing B: account eligible source changes
outcome: An execution_observe request under account_if_eligible enters source-change accounting exactly when an explicit, current policy basis selects it on an eligible unfinished run, and otherwise is kept as audit-only with a stated reason; the accounting-unavailable refusal is removed.
acceptance: A late report after completion leaves the original seal bytes unchanged; doctor, integrity and migration accept the accounted kinds and their obligations (tests)

A newer claim or fence, or a released or superseded binding, gives audit_only historical_binding; a moved root basis gives root_basis_moved; a finished run gives finished_run; each opens nothing (tests)

An equal-revision report with no intervening different relevant revision in the same run/claim/workspace/root scope is a repeat linked to its anchor and opens nothing; A -> B -> A is a new change; watcher-only reports are never deduplicated (tests)

On an open run whose bound claim epoch is the run's latest (expired or not), with the captured root lifecycle still current, a reported source change accounts: it opens the selected rule set's obligations triggered by the record, advances source freshness and enters foreign-change classification, never renewing the claim or creating a grant (tests)
account_if_eligible names the project's current policy epoch, policy and rule set or is refused with execution_observation_policy_basis_mismatch and no effects (test)
behavioral-control-plane.md and cli-and-mcp.md document accounting and drop the accounting-unavailable refusal
source_change:null and a standalone observed_check give no_source_change, clear nothing and advance no freshness; nested check sources never count as source sightings (tests)

completion.summary: execution_observe under account_if_eligible enters source-change accounting: current-policy refusal, lifecycle audit reasons, workspace-scoped repeats, new changes that open obligations at their own position, the SourceObservation view across readers, and the architects' barrier rule (producer/evidence after P, completed_at floor, measured-sighting revision) in obligation satisfaction, bound-criterion freshness and evaluation F8; doctor re-decides at the position before each record. Landed as 02ce59f on origin master after six review rounds and a passing independent evaluation (45a2996d, 7/7).
